g.text: Weigh + plot + counsel (M02!) + vaccines + vitamin A + deworm + IYCF demo + sick-child triage
+ defaulters listed + pregnant/lactating counselled. Fast queues + kind words + charts handed
over = retention. "Weighing day is village health day" — drum, mobilise, celebrate gains!
HARVEST
store (dry + raised +
pest-proof!) + sell
surplus smart +
save seeds
LEAN SEASON
stored grains + dried
fish + groundnut +
garden greens +
screen MORE!
RAINS/MALARIA
nets + test/treat +
diarrhoea WASH +
growth watch (illness
flattens curves!)
HOME GARDENS (vitamins at the doorstep): kontomire + moringa + orange sweet potato
+ pawpaw + pepper + beans — demo plots at CHPS/schools/churches; seeds shared; harvest
taught (pick + cook same day!). Poultry/rabbits/fishponds where apt (protein + income).
COOKING DEMOS (monthly!): enriched koko (M03!) + leaching (M04!) + ORS (M03/M06!) + rainbow
stews + complementary bowls — mothers COOK (not watch!), taste, take recipe cards, teach-back.
Grandmothers + fathers invited — family decisions need family demos.
SCHOOLS: feeding enrol + VERIFY eating (not selling!) + deworm + vision + gardens + WASH +
nutrition lessons (rainbow plates drawn!). MARKETS/MOSQUES/CHURCHES: salt checks, MUAC
screening days, drama/songs, weighing + counsel pop-ups.
RECORDS → ACTION: registers complete + DHIMS entered + defaulters TRACED (home visit, not
scolding!) + data reviewed monthly (PRO-II M4: coverage? SAM finds? faltering? — act on gaps).
Data cooked = children missed (PRO-II M5 warning stands!).
PARTNERS: chiefs/assembly (mobilise!) + agric extension (seeds/storage!) + environmental
health (vendors/water!) + welfare (LEAP/vulnerable!) + NGOs (supplies/training!) + TBAs (ANC
allies!) — nurses CONVENE (PRO-II M5 ladder: ward data → district forums!).
Exam line: \"weigh monthly, demo always, trace kindly — gardens grow vitamins home.\"
